status_lines: INDEPENDENT EVALUATION NOT AUTHORIZED OR CONDUCTED
statement: A narrow correction to the Phase 8.2 governance design before Phase 9 admission. Not a new phase. It does not alter any Engine conclusion, evaluation status or release status, and it does not describe the earlier Phase 8.2 result as invalid.

isolated_replay.environment: temporary git clone outside the repository at 428c307 plus the recorded Phase 6, Phase 7 and Phase 8.2 files only (364 files, each matched to its recorded hash; clone untracked set equal to the planned set)

framing_correction: The Phase 8.2 checks "recording the authorization created no registry reservation", "no Phase 9 file or directory exists" and probe p82.authorization_created_no_reservation were framed as permanent absence checks. They were true when Phase 8.2 completed and are now historical-scope checks against this record. The earlier result is not invalid.

corrections.now: historical-scope check against phase8_2_historical_state, plus a current check that any reservation under the authorization exists only through a valid admission made after Phase 8.2 completed

corrections.item: run.mjs "no Phase 9 file or directory exists"
corrections.now: historical-scope check (no Phase 9 path at Phase 8.2 completion), plus a current check that every Phase 9 path is owned by an admitted registry entry

corrections.now: p82.authorization_reservations_only_through_admission: reservations exist only as admitted entries tied to the authorization, admitted after Phase 8.2 completed

temporary_copy_simulation.first_simulation_findings: The first simulation run exposed two probe defects introduced in this correction, fixed before the recorded runs: synthetic-entry probes replaced the recorded decided references with a test-only set, and three synthetic-state probes classified the live worktree together with their synthetic files.
